description: Extracts firearm technical specifications (caliber, action, weight, length, rate of fire, etc.) from modernfirearms.net firearm record pages.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_firearm_specifications: 从指定URL提取枪械技术规格; 需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - search_firearms: 搜索枪械 (功能受限); 需要query参数; 参数: query, limit; 必填: 无

url.description: modernfirearms.net上的枪械页面完整URL (用于get_firearm_specifications)

limit.description: 返回结果数量限制 (用于search_firearms，默认10)
